An AI-Podcast 


This podcast is entirely generated and operated by AI — and that is by design. While this inevitably puts us in competition for the same audience as human-created content, particularly journalism and other podcasts, we recognize that an AI-driven format cannot be a replacement for those. Europe Weekly's goal is to make journalistic content more accessible to audiences who might not otherwise have easy access to it. At the same time, we acknowledge that this is only possible as long as a healthy journalistic public discourse exists — one that can be monitored and used as input for this podcast.

This creates a dilemma we've been aware of from the start: we compete with what we depend on and deeply value. Europe Weekly currently has no significant audience, but our aim is to reach people and spark their interest in European affairs. Should that one day translate into a meaningful audience that can be monetized, we would reinvest part of those proceeds into improving the product. Any remaining revenue we would donate to independent journalism, with the long-term vision of becoming a non-profit organization. The exact structure of how to do this doesn't need to be defined right now — there are, after all, no proceeds yet.
